entries.title: Solo founders: how do you stay emotionally efficient?
entries.author: dangrover
entries.current_title: Solo founders: how do you stay emotionally efficient?
entries.excerpt: There's a great online book called "The Hacker's Diet" (http://www.fourmilab.ch/hackdiet/www/hackdiet.html) which is a no-bullshit dieting/fitness book written by an engineer with the assumption that the reader is fairly smart and rational. He even has some nifty Excel charts. I lost 50 pounds with his approach. Self-help books are usually total drivel with no respect for the reader, so I wish there were tons more written like this one, but on other topics. But I figure start

entries.title: Tell YC: Thanks for Startup School
entries.author: thomasswift
entries.current_title: Tell YC: Thanks for Startup School
entries.excerpt: I'm not asking anything, I'm telling. I just wanted to say thanks for organizing this event. Coming from outside the valley, it's a little harder to get access to learn from such high-profile people. I had a wonderful time connecting with different people and hearing their stories and startups. Good luck to everyone I talked to that have YC interviews! Thanks again YCombinator and everyone who made it possible. I had a great time and learned a lot.
entries.guide_zh: 来自硅谷之外的参与者感谢 Startup School 带来的学习与交流。

entries.title: Y Combinator Dataset Of Posts
